ideas.pitch: A high-precision differential-drive line-following robot featuring real-time PID tuning and multi-sensor array feedback to conquer sharp curves and high-speed straightaways without drifting.
ideas.problem_statement: Autonomous bot time trial navigating a predefined track with sharp turns, speed, precision, and accuracy within a 3-hour live challenge.
ideas.title: PID-Tuned Adaptive Speed Line Follower
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a live, working demo with flawless hardware calibration, matching the winning pattern of a physical build that operates reliably under time constraints.

ideas.pitch: An advanced autonomous robot equipped with both IR reflectance and inductive sensors to seamlessly handle standard line tracks as well as complex intermittent path markers.
ideas.problem_statement: Autonomous bot time trial navigating a predefined track with variations, turns, and precision constraints.
ideas.title: Dual-Mode Optical & Magnetic Line Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: By incorporating dual-sensor redundancy, it directly addresses track variations better than standard single-sensor builds, standing out to judges looking for engineering robustness.

ideas.pitch: An onboard ESP-NOW wireless telemetry module that streams exact lap times, wheel speeds, and sensor error metrics to a sideline laptop interface for instant performance tuning.
ideas.problem_statement: Autonomous bot time trial evaluating performance on the given line-following track with speed, precision, and accuracy.
ideas.title: Telemetry-Linked Lap Timer & Bot Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Most teams will focus purely on hardware; adding a live telemetry dashboard gives judges unprecedented visibility into the robot's algorithmic performance.

ideas.pitch: A smart line follower capable of detecting intersection nodes, logging path logic via onboard EEPROM, and optimizing its trajectory on subsequent laps for record-breaking speed trials.
ideas.problem_statement: Autonomous bot following a predefined track while navigating turns and track variations with speed, precision, and accuracy.
ideas.title: Junction-Mapping Autonomous Maze & Line Solver
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates algorithmic intelligence over brute-force hardware speed, making it uniquely sophisticated among standard time-trial competitors.

ideas.pitch: An ultra-lightweight, low-center-of-gravity 3D-printed chassis optimized for maximum acceleration and tight cornering grip during high-stakes competitive time trials.
ideas.problem_statement: Design and operate an autonomous bot capable of following a predefined track while navigating turns and track variations with speed, precision, and accuracy.
ideas.title: Modular Chassis 3D-Printed Speedster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines custom hardware fabrication with rigorous physical testing, leveraging the proven winning pattern of an unusual and polished physical build.
